input.job_description: We seek a junior software developer with Python, SQL, React and Flask experience to build accessible dashboards, design REST APIs, write automated tests, collaborate with engineers and optimize database performance.

expected: 200; handle resume without standard section headings

action_plan: Include these role-specific keywords naturally in skills and project bullets: seek, junior, software, developer, experience.
Rewrite the top 2 project bullets so they directly mirror this job's responsibilities.
Add metrics to at least 3 bullets using a format like: improved X by Y% / reduced Z by Y hours.
Add a dedicated Skills section with grouped tools and languages.
Add a Projects section with 2-4 relevant projects.

interview_focus: Provide concrete examples of specific projects built using the mentioned stack
Detail the testing frameworks used and their impact on code quality
Explain how you collaborated with other engineers during your development process
rewritten_bullets: Developed a responsive dashboard using React and Flask backend with Python data processing capabilities.
Designed and tested RESTful APIs ensuring reliability through automated unit testing frameworks.
Optimized SQL database queries to improve system performance for dashboard data retrieval.
